t.en: The “and” of <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref> takes “it rains” first, then “it is windy”. Would the other order do? Can test cases tell?
Declaration 1 takes “it rains” first, declaration 2 “it is windy” first. Write a case for each direction, introduction and use, expected derivable, and check both declarations.

after.en: Test cases see only what can be derived, not how a rule is written; the kernel keeps to the rule written down.

brief.en: Requirement: “it rains and it is windy” may be introduced only when “it rains” and “it is windy” are both proved. Write two test cases whose expectations meet the requirement and with which both declarations’ results agree.

hint.en: What does introducing “and” need? What can be taken out of an “and”?
